main_text.p: Τραπέζα, mensa, pegma : a trap.decipulum : id est, ut Had. Junius in doctissimo Nomenclatore pluribus explicat, Laqueus quidam aut machina irretiendis aviculis, aut capiendis bestiis comparata.

Τρώξλης, comestor, (à τρώγω scilicet, arrodo, rodo, comedo :) vorator. Ita dicitur & Homero (ut viri doctiss. Camerarius & Steph. in suis uterque Thesauris:) qui ut habeat quod voret, quavis arte lucrum facit. Atque hæc est Eustathii & Hesychii, quorum verba Stephanus adduxit, expositio. Est autem verbum Homericum. Homeri verba quæ ab illis afferuntur, sunt hæc : ex Odyss. ζ.
main_text.l: ἉΛΛ' ὅτε δὴ ἔσσυτο μοι ἐπιπλόμενον ἔτος ἦλθε,
Αὐ τότε φοῖνιξ ἦλθεν ἀνὴρ ἀπάλιντα ἐιδός,
main_text.p: id est, Sed cum octavus mihi rediens annus venit, jam tunc Phœnix vir fallacius sciens, Τρώξλης, &c.
main_text.l: Ἐν δὲ ᾗ φοίνικες ναυσὶν ἁλνὸν ἥλυθον ἀνδρες

page.notes: Greek text is partly damaged and uncertain in places; the handwritten "486" in the margin is a manuscript annotation and was not transcribed. Greek lines were transcribed as best read and may contain errors.
